title: dynamic-qa Provenance Manifest v1
description: Strict, versioned contract for the customer file <repository>/qa/provenance.json (DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.5, SPEC-135.md user story 54). Records, for every current or adopted Binding, exactly what generation used to produce it and what it produced. Runtime test results never enter this file. Deterministically ordered: bindings are sorted by flowId, and every order-insignificant collection inside a record is sorted, so re-running generation against identical inputs produces byte-identical output. This document is the human-readable contract; dynamic-qa/shared/scripts/provenance.mjs is the hand-written fail-closed validator, builder, and canonical-ordering module that enforces and produces it (no JSON Schema validator dependency is added — see dynamic-qa/DECISIONS.md and the run brief's deterministic-core decision).

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value, including a plausible future version string, is an unsupported-schema-version error, not a silent upgrade attempt.

generatedAt.description: Caller-supplied timestamp (an injected clock, per the bundle's determinism rule — never computed internally by the writer, so identical inputs always produce identical bytes).

bindings.description: One record per current or adopted Binding, sorted by flowId. A flowId may appear at most once: regenerating a flow replaces its record rather than appending a duplicate.

flowId.description: The Flow Definition's immutable, semantic id.

flowRevision.description: The Flow Definition's revision at generation time. Must never regress against a revision already recorded for the same flowId (see provenance.mjs checkRevisionMonotonic).

flowDigest.description: canonical-digest.mjs contentDigest over the validated Flow Definition data model.

originTickets.description: Copied from the Flow Definition's origin.tickets, sorted.

dataSets.description: One entry per referenced Named Data Set, sorted by id.

digest.description: contentDigest over the validated Named Data Set data model.

flow.description: Digest of the pinned dynamic-qa-flow-v1 schema text in use at generation time.

data.description: Digest of the pinned dynamic-qa-data-v1 schema text in use at generation time.

testLevel.description: The selected test level and whether it was inferred or an approved override, mirroring the Flow Definition's own test_level shape.

sourceCommit.description: The exact source commit the candidate Binding was verified against.

contentDigest.description: Content digest identifying the exact generator/bundle code used.

harness.description: Coding harness/model used for authoring. Required when identity is "generated".

adoptedFrom.description: Path to the pre-existing test this Binding was adopted from. Required when identity is "adopted".

outputs.description: Every Binding output file path this Binding wrote, sorted by path.

impactPaths.description: Conservative product-impact path globs, sorted. A trigger hint, never proof.

enforcementLane.description: Brownfield Bindings enter advisory during burn-in; a first active greenfield Binding defaults to required.

id.description: Reference by id only. The Execution Profile artifact itself is #150's, not this schema's.
